verdict.rationale: vLLM is an API server, so publishing a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only an OpenAI-compatible API, Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support (vllm-docs-9, vllm-docs-27). Nothing documents a downloadable machine-readable spec such as an openapi.json endpoint or published protobuf/OpenAPI files, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.
